items.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
孟子 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly, for example 孟子这个孩子, instead of using only his name.
孟母 appears for the first time, so please introduce her briefly as 孟子的妈妈 or 孟母亲, rather than only using her name.
住在 describes a state, so do not put 了 before 在. Use 住在+Place.
For “near the cemetery,” use 靠近墓地. 靠近 is the natural word here.
It would be more natural to add 里 to make the place clear: 家里.
每天 describes a habitual action, not a completed action. Do not use sentence-final 了 here.
It would be more natural to say 他们住的城市, because no city has been introduced for 那个城市 to refer to.
It would be more natural to use 在 for an action in progress: 从早到晚都在找工作.
It would be more natural to use 是因为 to show the reason clearly: 原来是因为买不了房.
Put the directional complement 到 before 了: 搬到了一个城市. This shows the move was completed.
It would be more natural to use 搬到了+Place for moving to a place. Do not leave 搬了 directly before the place.
Use 另一个 for “another”: 另一个城市 is the standard expression.
